title: Error budget currency and initiative scorecard for reliability decisions
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Teams decide on reliability trade-offs in isolation; we lack a single, comparable unit to make cross-initiative prioritization and fast rollback decisions.

Goal: Create an "error budget as currency" model and an initiative scorecard that converts SLIs, burn rates, and runway into a single, explainable signal for PMs and engineering leads. This signal should power a console widget and an internal API that recommends throttles, canary sizes, or temporary feature gating when the combined portfolio risk exceeds tolerated thresholds.

Approach:
- Define the 'budget unit' (BBU) that normalizes different SLI shapes (latency, availability, correctness) using user impact weights and historical recovery times.
- Build a scoring engine that consumes SLI time-series, current burn rate, on-call capacity, and initiative priority to produce: initiative_score, portfolio_exposure, and suggested_action (none/throttle/canary/rollback).
- Surface a read-only initiative scorecard in Console with time-series, contributing SLIs, current BBU balance, and one-click recommended actions.
- Run a 6-week pilot with two product areas (Hosted API / Dedicated) to validate the BBU mapping and the recommendation precision.

Out of scope: automated enforcement (we will only surface recommendations in the pilot), billing changes, and RBAC for cross-org approvals.
acceptance_criteria: BBU definition document reviewed and approved by Reliability and Product (doc link).
Scoring engine prototype that computes initiative_score and portfolio_exposure from historical SLI data for three sample initiatives.
Console scorecard UI mockups with interactive drilldowns and recommended_action states approved by design and PM.
Pilot run for 6 weeks with at least two initiatives; pilot analysis shows recommendations would have averted >=1 outage or reduced error budget exhaustion by >=15% in at least one case.
Internal API and a demo integration with the rollout/orchestrator service (read-only) available for experiments.

Time to triage for SLI alerts decreased by 25% when scorecard is used
